native_command:
set -eu
git clone --depth 1 --branch v0.6 https://github.com/facebookresearch/detectron2 /opt/detectron2
test "$(git -C /opt/detectron2 rev-parse HEAD)" = d1e04565d3bec8719335b88be9e9b961bf3ec464
python -m pip wheel --no-build-isolation --no-deps /opt/detectron2 --wheel-dir "$1/wheels"
python -m pip install --no-deps "$1"/wheels/*.whl
python /work/faster_run.py --probe --output "$1"
